note: The ladder is real and so are the first steps. The runbooks themselves are not published — they describe a private estate — and `runbook: documented, not published` is the honest way to say that rather than pretending they do not exist.

levels.definition: data is at risk, or something irreplaceable is not being recorded
levels.first_step: stop the thing that is still writing before diagnosing the thing that broke

levels.definition: degraded, someone notices, no data at risk
levels.first_step: establish whether the exporter is down or the thing it exports is down — they look identical from here

levels.definition: an alert fired and nothing is actually wrong
levels.first_step: fix the alert, not the service; a rule that cries wolf is the outage

levels.definition: noticed in passing, nothing is on fire
levels.first_step: write the row before fixing it, or the fix will be the only record
